exec.json.description: aos-exec: run one entry (a file, a folder with _entry, FILE#/POINTER) with its workspace and stack set up.

loop.json.description: aos-loop: run a body again and again until it exits 10; ctl and state windows, on_start, on_stop.

fsm.json.description: aos-fsm: run one step of a state table and move to the next state by exit code.

daemon.json.description: aos-daemon: the daemon itself, looking after a table of procs; start it through a definition's _entry.

post.json.description: aos-post: mailboxes and letters: init, send, take, see, done, regret.

lock.json.description: aos-lock: take, release and show a lock next to a file or folder.

json.json.description: aos-json: read and edit aos JSON files by FILE#/POINTER, follow $ref, check directives.

directive.json.description: aos-directive: resolve $ref, $env and $path in a JSON document read from stdin.

llm.json.description: aos-llm: send requests to the llm kernel, read the replies, list endpoint packs.

llm_kernel.json.description: aos-llm-kernel: one round of the llm kernel (the body of its daemon); how to start the kernel.

_description.json.description: Low-level parts: what they are for, where their flags go, and that exit 10 means nothing there.
